profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Lead developer of one of the best mobile apps of 2015 worldwide and responsible of AppStore featured apps. 

Previously researcher at CRISES Research Group and the UNESCO Chair in Data Privacy in the Department of Computer Science and Mathematics at Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV) of Tarragona, Catalonia, Spain.

PhD in Security and Privacy in the field of Computer Science. MSc in Computer Science from Rovira i Virgili University. BSc in Computer Science from University of Lleida.

Previously working as a Software Engineer at Microsoft with OneDrive and SharePoint, previously Teams and Skype for Business.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: iOS Developer at OneDrive and SharePoint

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as an iOS Developer @ Skype for business and Teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Senior iOS Developer, focusing on applying the newest design patterns to the base code. 
Responsible of the Zoom and in-app delivery features among others.

positions.title: Lead iOS Developer
positions.description:
Responsible of the development of the iOS apps for OpenSignal, including apps as OpenSignal, WeatherSignal and WifiMapper.

These apps were highlighted several times in the AppStore as "Best new apps", and WifiMapper was one of the best apps worldwide of 2015.

positions.title: Predoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
Predoctoral researcher at CRISES Research group and the UNESCO Chair in Data Privacy in the Department of Computer Science and Mathematics at Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV) of Tarragona, Catalonia, Spain.

Focused on Privacy protection and Security in ubiquitous computing.

Author of several publications in international conferences and journals, three of these publications on the top 3 best journals worldwide in Computer Science and Telecommunications.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
As the first iOS developer at BuscoUnChollo.com I built the first iOS app for this product, which generated the 5% of total revenue of the company within the first year.

The app was on the general top 25 ranking in the AppStore for a long time.
